title: REALM: Recursive Relevance Modeling for LLM-based Document Re-Ranking
authors: Pinhuan Wang; Zhiqiu Xia; Chunhua Liao; Feiyi Wang; Hang Liu
why_relevant: Proposes an uncertainty-aware LLM re-ranker using Bayesian updates over Gaussian relevance distributions, touching on ranking uncertainty.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on re-ranking efficiency/stability, not on RAG robustness to noisy/adversarial/conflicting evidence or generator-side calibration.
